issues.description: The Person model's firstName field has different visibility across artifacts: the problem statement's UML and the template declare firstName as a private field with public getter/setter, whereas the solution's Person.java makes firstName a public field. This inconsistency contradicts the encapsulation shown in the UML and may confuse students about the intended field visibility and use of getters/setters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of the firstName field consistent. Prefer restoring encapsulation: change the solution's Person.java to declare firstName as private and rely on the existing public getter/setter (matching the template and UML). Alternatively, update the UML/problem statement and template to document the field as public if that was intentional.
